name: DJ TechTools Midi Fighter Twister
description: 16 encoders x 4 hardware banks, driven by the app. Encoder turns on ch1 (CC = knob + 16 * bank), encoder switches on ch2 with the same CC numbers, all six side buttons on ch4 as plain CC buttons, six per bank (bank n, 0-based: 8+6n..13+6n, in the order left-top, left-middle, left-bottom, right-top, right-middle, right-bottom). The app owns the banks: right-top steps to the next bank (shift + right-top: previous), the app shows the bank's page and sends the bank change to the device, so the device's own Previous/Next Bank buttons must not be used. The 16 knobs control the Perform view's visible 4x4 knob grid: bank 1 shows Deck A and Deck B (each a pinned SRC row over a pinned FX row), bank 2 shows Deck BG and Deck PV the same way, bank 3 shows Master MIX, Master FX, Transitions and Clock & Global. Pages are set by `banks.pages`; see library/perform_pages for adding your own. Rings show each knob's value and the LEDs take the row colour (dark for a bypassed or empty slot); the lights are written to the bank that is showing. Switch tap = primary action (FX slot bypass / reset to default); shift + tap = secondary (focus FX slot, leave focus, next parameter page); turn while holding the switch = fine. Left-middle toggles Chain Link on the FX chain of the row you touched last (shift + left-middle: tap tempo). Left-top, right-middle and right-bottom navigate (Perform view: left-top back, shift + left-top toggles Edit mode, right-middle opens the Library, right-bottom opens the picker of the last-touched knob's row, shift + right-bottom toggles Pair view; Library: left-top back, right-middle steps the tab, right-bottom steps the list, knob 16 is the cursor: turn = step, tap = load or apply, shift + tap = add to the A/B queue; shift + side buttons add to the BG queue and step backwards). Left-bottom is Shift. Load midi-fighter-twister.mfs into the Midi Fighter Utility to set the device up: all encoders relative (ENC 3FH/41H), all switches and side buttons CC Hold, every LED black in both states.
